description: Monitor and switch cswap accounts entirely inside VS Code: SwapDeck view in the activity bar, status bar, quick switch, notifications and engine.
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often to read `cswap list`, in seconds.
config.cliPath: Absolute path of `swapdeck-cli`. Empty: the one bundled with the extension.
config.engine.enabled: Run the SwapDeck engine (`swapdeck-cli headless`) while VS Code is open: it records the history, sends the notifications and, when the engine is on in Rules, switches accounts. One engine per user across all windows (lock): the others observe and take over when it closes.
config.notifications.thresholds: Usage thresholds (%) for the status bar colors: the lowest as a warning, the highest as critical. Notifications follow the SwapDeck rules (notifications section of the config).
